placeabout.heading: About this place
placeabout.description:
Snuff Mills offers a riverside setting within reach of Bristol neighbourhoods. You can enjoy a short visit around the park or use the wider Oldbury Court paths for a longer outing.

Our family idea: take a quiet moment to listen to the river, then look for changes in the plants along the path. Turn back while everyone still has enough energy for the return journey.

placepracticalinfo.heading: Practical information
placepracticalinfo.bestFor: Families who enjoy gentle-paced riverside exploring.
placepracticalinfo.facilities: Community garden, tea hut and toilets at the Snuff Mills car park.
placepracticalinfo.parking: Use the Snuff Mills car park at the end of River View and check charges and closing times.
placepracticalinfo.goodToKnow: The river is close to sections of path. Supervise children, expect mud after rain and consult access information for buggy or wheelchair routes.
